messages:
sasha: Hey team, heads up — PR #9876 is blocked by CI again. The integration job intermittently fails on `integration/session_timeout.test.js` during the merge check. Failing snippet below:
```
FAIL tests/integration/session_timeout.test.js
  ● integration › session timeout › resets session after idle

  Expected: 200
  Received: 504

  at Object.<anonymous> (tests/integration/session_timeout.test.js:42:15)
  at async Promise.all (index 0)
```
This is happening ~50% of runs. Can someone take a look?

liam: I've seen that flake a few times this week. It's a timing-sensitive e2e that depends on a short timeout + noisy CI machines. Repro locally with:
```bash
docker-compose run --rm test npm run test -- tests/integration/session_timeout.test.js --runInBand
```
If you run it several times under load you can reproduce. Quick fix is to bump the jest timeout for that test to 60s (jest.setTimeout(60000)) or switch to a polling-based wait for the session to actually expire.

nina: I can take a stab. Two options: 1) increase timeout in the test and add a short retry in the test harness, or 2) mark test as flaky in CI so merges aren't blocked and we schedule a follow-up. Prefer 1 for now.

liam: Also FYI the flake sometimes causes a snapshot mismatch in `SessionView.snap` because the timestamp field becomes `expired` in some runs. If we change timeout we should re-run snapshot update locally: `yarn test -u tests/integration --testPathPattern=session_timeout`

nina: copying steps: 1) pull the branch, 2) update test to `jest.setTimeout(60000)` at top of file, 3) run the single test with `--updateSnapshot` to refresh, 4) push branch. I'll do this and run the CI rerun.

ci-bot: @nina requested a rerun for pipeline 48291 (PR #9876). Queueing job...

devops-bot: Note: rerun counts for this PR = 2. If it exceeds 5 the CI queue will auto-rate-limit.

nina: Pushed change `test(session): increase timeout + update snapshot` — PR updated. Kicked off rerun.

ci-bot: pipeline 48291 started (job: integration-tests). Logs: https://ci.example.com/48291

sasha: Thanks — do we need to add a small comment in the test pointing to the flake so it doesn't get regressed later?

liam: Yes please add a short comment linking to this thread and a TODO to revisit with infra improvements. Also add `// flake: high` label in the test file header so annotators see it.

nina: Added comment and pushed. Rerun status: integration-tests job succeeded ✅ (all tests green). Full pipeline passed.

ci-bot: pipeline 48291 succeeded.

nina: @sasha I can merge unless you want to double-check anything.

sasha: Go ahead and merge :shipit: — thanks for the quick turnaround.

jen: FYI I'll include this in the next hotfix train in case anything else pops up.

liam: Filed follow-up issue (#1102) to remove the fudge timeout once we can stabilize infra.

sasha: Great. Closing the loop — marking PR unblocked and merging. :thumbsup:
